module: Flowgraph node "Show/Hide Object" (repeat_instant). Hides or shows a scene object. Inputs: objID (number), hide (bool, true = hide). Sets obj.hidden then calls updateInstanceRenderData if the object has it.
notes: If the id matches no object, obj is nil and the assignment obj.hidden raises a Lua error (no guard).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Finds the object by id and applies hidden; reports the error "objID must be set" if the pin is empty.
